facts.fact: Three of the twelve redbark packets were ruined on the Goat's Teeth (two split along the fold, one damp-set like clay); nine sound packets at two courses each give eighteen courses.
Forty-one are sick in Ranu: eighteen get a course (Sunni last on the list, third water at dusk) and twenty-three do not.
Each trip to the nearest well (a hundred paces from Nimmi's house) takes Meera and Rohan about a quarter hour together, because the rope forces Meera to walk it with him; this delays the waters.
